name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px solid border focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast. This matches WCAG 2.2 AA for interactive elements, ensuring visibility for users with low vision or in bright light. The thicker border improves touch accuracy on mobile without sacrificing clarity. Trade-off: slightly larger ring size, but it’s a necessary compromise for both keyboard and touch users.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring at 4.5:1 still fails users who need *both* high contrast *and* reduced motion—they see a jarring flash on every tab. A 3px ring at 7:1 contrast avoids this by reducing flicker while keeping touch accuracy. Settle it with real user testing: measure task completion time and comfort for both groups.
